title: 功夫
creator: 周星驰
note: 把武侠、漫画与特效熔成一场草根逆袭的热血狂欢，金像奖最佳影片证明了它的成色。
noteEn: Stephen Chow fuses kung fu, comics and CGI into a riotous underdog fantasy that swept the HK Film Awards.

title: 大话西游之大圣娶亲
en: A Chinese Odyssey Part Two: Cinderella
creator: 刘镇伟
note: 至尊宝那句「一万年」的台词被华人影迷背了大半生，无厘头里藏的是放不下的遗憾。
noteEn: The 'ten thousand years' vow that Chinese audiences still quote — absurdist comedy hiding deep regret.

title: 唐伯虎点秋香
creator: 李力持
note: 「小强」与「旺财」的梗从这里走向全国，周星驰古装无厘头的最巅峰之一。
noteEn: Where the 'Little Qiang' cockroach meme was born — peak costume mo-lei-tau from Stephen Chow.

title: 东成西就
creator: 刘镇伟
note: 全港顶流明星贺岁反串大乱斗，一本正经地讲最离谱的笑话，港产喜剧的年味担当。
noteEn: Every HK star of the era in gender-bending holiday chaos — Lunar New Year comedy at its most unhinged.

title: 虎口脱险
creator: Gérard Oury
note: 二战逃亡路上两位法国平民把德军耍得团团转，法式喜剧的国民记忆。
noteEn: A WWII cat-and-mouse farce of civilians outwitting the Germans — France's beloved national comedy.

title: 天使爱美丽
creator: Jean-Pierre Jeunet
note: 巴黎女孩用一连串恶作剧式的善举点亮他人的生活，把平凡日子过成了童话。
noteEn: A Parisian girl quietly rewrites strangers' lives with whimsical acts of kindness.

title: 巨蟒与圣杯
en: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
creator: Terry Gilliam & Terry Jones
note: 用椰子壳当马蹄、骑着假马「攻城」的荒诞亚瑟王传奇，英式无厘头的圣杯。
noteEn: King Arthur's quest with coconuts for hoofbeats — the holy grail of absurdist British comedy.

title: 一条叫旺达的鱼
creator: Charles Crichton
note: 一伙笨贼为钻石互相背叛，凯文·克莱恩演的「愚蠢至极」骗过所有观众拿下奥斯卡男配。
noteEn: Diamond thieves double-crossing each other — Kevin Kline's idiot act won him an Oscar.

title: 热情似火
creator: Billy Wilder
note: 逃命的乐手男扮女装混入女子乐团，结尾那句「没有人是完美的」是影史最妙收场。
noteEn: Musicians on the run in drag — 'Nobody's perfect' remains one of cinema's greatest punchlines.

title: 安妮·霍尔
creator: Woody Allen
note: 把神经质知识分子的爱情拍成打破第四面墙的话痨拼贴画，改写了好莱坞爱情喜剧的语法。
noteEn: Neurotic intellectual romance as a wall-breaking collage of gags — rewrote the romantic comedy grammar.

title: 土拨鼠之日
creator: Harold Ramis
note: 被困在同一天的主角被迫一遍遍重活，直到学会善良——所有时间循环片的祖本。
noteEn: A man relives the same day until he learns kindness — the ur-text of every time-loop comedy.

title: 宿醉
creator: Todd Phillips
note: 婚礼前夜的烂醉狂欢换来一觉醒来丢了新娘子，R 级疯狂喜剧史上最黑的票房黑马。
noteEn: A bachelor party blackout that loses the groom — the R-rated comedy that took Vegas by storm.

title: 疯狂的石头
creator: 宁浩
note: 一块翡翠引来的多线混战，小成本黑色喜剧让「石头」成了内地喜剧的新标杆。
noteEn: A jade stone ignites a multi-strand scramble — the low-budget hit that rebooted mainland comedy.

title: 甲方乙方
creator: 冯小刚
note: 「好梦一日游」替人圆梦的荒诞生意，冯氏幽默与内地贺岁片的开山之作。
noteEn: A company that rents out fantasy lives — the film that launched Feng Xiaogang's New Year comedy tradition.

title: 两杆大烟枪
en: Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels
creator: Guy Ritchie
note: 四组人马围绕两把古董枪的多线混剪，盖·里奇把英伦黑帮喜剧拍得眼花缭乱。
noteEn: Four gangs collide over two antique guns in a dazzling braid — Ritchie's dazzling calling card.

title: 谋杀绿脚趾
creator: Joel & Ethan Coen
note: 一个被误认的「督爷」卷进荒唐绑架案，慵懒哲学与白俄罗斯人的邪典狂欢。
noteEn: A case of mistaken identity drags a slacker into absurd chaos — the Dude abides.

title: 城市之光
creator: Charlie Chaplin
note: 流浪汉爱上盲女，用无声与配乐写尽最温柔的体面，卓别林喜剧里的一滴泪。
noteEn: A tramp's love for a blind flower girl — silent comedy with the gentlest of hearts.

title: 摩登时代
creator: Charlie Chaplin
note: 流水线上拧螺丝的工人被机器吞进齿轮，工业时代最后的伟大默片喜剧。
noteEn: A factory worker devoured by the assembly line — the last great comedy of the silent era.

title: 将军号
creator: Buster Keaton & Clyde Bruckman
note: 实拍的真实火车追逐至今让人手心冒汗，基顿面无表情的「石头脸」把特技喜剧推到顶峰。
noteEn: A real locomotive chase that still dazzles — Keaton's stone-faced stunt comedy at its peak.

title: 三傻大闹宝莱坞
creator: Rajkumar Hirani
note: 「追求卓越，成功自然来」——印度教育体制下三个好友的青春反叛与温情。
noteEn: Three friends rebel against rote schooling — Bollywood's anthem for learning with joy.

title: 命运的捉弄
creator: Eldar Ryazanov
note: 醉汉被误送进另一座城市同一条街同一号房，俄罗斯除夕夜年年重播的国民爱情喜剧。
noteEn: A drunkard wakes in an identical apartment in another city — Russia's New Year's Eve staple.

title: 波拉特
creator: Larry Charles
note: 哈萨克记者闯荡美国的伪纪录片，用一路冒犯测试西方社会的每一根神经。
noteEn: A mockumentary provocation that tests America's tolerance with total impunity.

title: 美丽人生
creator: Roberto Benigni
note: 父亲用游戏与谎言为儿子守住集中营里的童年，把最残酷的历史讲成最温柔的爱。
noteEn: A father turns the Holocaust into a game to protect his son — tragedy told as the gentlest love.

title: 卡萨布兰卡
creator: Michael Curtiz
note: 「世界上有那么多城镇，她却走进了我的」——战时爱情与牺牲的永恒范本。
noteEn: 'Of all the gin joints in all the towns in all the world' — romance and sacrifice under war.

title: 罗马假日
creator: William Wyler
note: 公主与记者的一天「私奔」，奥黛丽·赫本以一头短发成了银幕上最亮的光。
noteEn: A princess's one-day escape with a reporter — Audrey Hepburn's luminous breakthrough.

title: 乱世佳人
creator: Victor Fleming
note: 南北战争的硝烟里，斯嘉丽那句「明天又是新的一天」撑起整部南方史诗。
noteEn: Scarlett's 'tomorrow is another day' through the ashes of the Civil War South.

title: 泰坦尼克号
creator: James Cameron
note: 杰克与露丝的生死之恋沉入大西洋，也沉进几代人的记忆深处。
noteEn: Jack and Rose's doomed love sinks into the Atlantic — and into global memory.

title: 断背山
creator: Ang Lee
note: 两个牛仔二十年压抑的深情，李安拍出了克制到极致的遗憾与思念。
noteEn: Two cowboys, two decades of suppressed love — Ang Lee's study in restraint and longing.

title: 爱在黎明破晓前
creator: Richard Linklater
note: 维也纳的一夜全靠聊天撑起，爱情被还原成最纯粹的交谈与可能性。
noteEn: One night of talk in Vienna — romance reduced to pure conversation and possibility.

title: 诺丁山
creator: Roger Michell
note: 书店老板与大明星的街角爱情，休·格兰特笨拙的真诚让人没法不喜欢。
noteEn: A bookseller and a movie star fall in love on a London street corner.

title: 傲慢与偏见
creator: Joe Wright
note: 达西先生清晨雾中走来的告白，把简·奥斯汀的机锋拍得又冷又烫。
noteEn: Mr. Darcy walking through the dawn mist — Austen's wit made cinematic and warm.

title: 甜蜜蜜
creator: 陈可辛
note: 邓丽君的歌声串起两个内地移民在香港的十年聚散，华语爱情片的一座高峰。
noteEn: Teresa Teng's songs carry a decade of separations and reunions — a peak of Chinese romance.

title: 重庆森林
creator: 王家卫
note: 金城武吃罐头、王菲晃荡的都市失恋絮语，杜可风手持镜头下的香港夜色。
noteEn: Two lovelorn cops drift through Hong Kong nights — Wong Kar-wai's city of loneliness.

title: 花样年华
creator: 王家卫
note: 旗袍与领带在走廊里反复错过，一段婚外情被拍成东方美学的极致暧昧。
noteEn: Cheongsam and tie brush past in a corridor — infidelity refined into pure style and longing.

title: 情书
creator: Shunji Iwai
note: 一封寄往天国的信牵出同名同姓的青春往事，雪国的暗恋温柔而悲伤。
noteEn: A letter to the dead uncovers a shared name and a buried teenage love.

title: 你的名字
creator: Makoto Shinkai
note: 互换身体的少男少女隔着时间与灾厄寻找彼此，新海诚美学的全球爆点。
noteEn: Body-swapping teens search for each other across time and disaster — Shinkai's global breakthrough.

title: 西西里的美丽传说
creator: Giuseppe Tornatore
note: 少年眼中风韵迷人的玛莲娜，是青春期欲望与小镇流言的残酷寓言。
noteEn: A boy's obsession with the beautiful Malèna — desire and rumor in a small Sicilian town.

title: 卧虎藏龙
creator: Ang Lee
note: 竹林之上的一场武斗，把武侠变成东方哲思与含蓄情欲的舞蹈。
noteEn: A bamboo-forest duel turns wuxia into a dance of philosophy and unspoken desire.

title: 怦然心动
creator: Rob Reiner
note: 一棵梧桐树上的风景，女孩先喜欢再离开——青春心动用双视角讲得又轻又重。
noteEn: A sycamore tree, first crushes and shifting perspectives — childhood love told from both sides.

title: 恋恋笔记本
creator: Nick Cassavetes
note: 养老院里每天重读的信，把一生一次的爱情讲给遗忘听。
noteEn: A love story read aloud to a fading memory — one lifetime, one true love.

title: 水形物语
creator: Guillermo del Toro
note: 清洁女工与水池怪物的跨物种之恋，冷战灰暗年代里最温柔的童话。
noteEn: A cleaner and an amphibian creature fall in love — a fairy tale inside the Cold War.

title: 雨中曲
creator: Gene Kelly & Stanley Donen
note: 从默片到有声片的转型闹剧，金·凯利雨中起舞的镜头定义了整个歌舞片类型。
noteEn: The silent-to-sound transition as a farce — Gene Kelly's rain dance defines the genre.

title: 西区故事
creator: Robert Wise & Jerome Robbins
note: 罗密欧与朱丽叶搬到纽约街头帮派，把歌舞推上社会冲突的舞台。
noteEn: Romeo and Juliet reimagined as New York street gangs — the musical as social tragedy.

title: 音乐之声
creator: Robert Wise
note: 修道院见习修女当上七个孩子的家庭教师，阿尔卑斯山上的歌声与自由。
noteEn: A postulant governess and seven children — songs of freedom above the Alps.

title: 歌厅
creator: Bob Fosse
note: 柏林夜总会的纸醉金迷掩盖着纳粹阴影，丽莎·明尼利的表演燃到极致。
noteEn: Berlin's decadent cabaret under the Nazi shadow — Liza Minnelli at full blaze.

title: 悲惨世界
creator: Tom Hooper
note: 全程现场收音的演唱式电影，让雨果的史诗在歌声里翻涌。
noteEn: Sung-through and recorded live on set, Hugo's epic surges through song.

title: 爱乐之城
creator: Damien Chazelle
note: 洛杉矶追梦者的爵士与霓虹，结尾那段蒙太奇是写给错过的挽歌。
noteEn: Dreamers, jazz and LA neon — a final montage that mourns the road not taken.

title: 波西米亚狂想曲
creator: Bryan Singer
note: 拉米·马雷克把弗雷迪·墨丘利「复活」在舞台上，Live Aid 一场封神。
noteEn: Rami Malek resurrects Freddie Mercury — the Live Aid sequence is pure legend.

title: 芝加哥
creator: Rob Marshall
note: 爵士时代的谋杀与名利场，监狱探戈和「All That Jazz」把罪恶跳成了欢场。
noteEn: Murder as entertainment in Jazz Age Chicago — prison tango and all that jazz.

title: 曾经
creator: John Carney
note: 都柏林街头卖唱者与卖花女的相遇，音乐本身就是他们的爱情信物。
noteEn: A busker and a flower-seller in Dublin — the songs are the love story.

title: 一个明星的诞生
creator: Bradley Cooper
note: 巨星陨落与新人升起同框，「Shallow」把爱情与才华的代价唱进骨头里。
noteEn: A legend fades as a star rises — 'Shallow' cuts to the bone of love and fame.

title: 歌剧魅影
creator: Joel Schumacher
note: 地下歌剧院的魅影与克里斯汀，韦伯音乐剧被搬上银幕的华丽版本。
noteEn: The Phantom beneath the Paris opera house — Webber's musical brought to lush life.

title: 放牛班的春天
creator: Christophe Barratier
note: 失意音乐老师用合唱团点亮问题少年，「池塘之底」的春天由歌声救赎。
noteEn: A teacher's choir transforms troubled boys — music as redemption for the lost.

title: 关山飞渡
creator: John Ford
note: 一辆驿车穿越 Apache 领地的公路冒险，约翰·韦恩由此登场，西部片语法的奠基作。
noteEn: A stagecoach run through Apache country — the ride that built John Wayne and the genre.

title: 正午
creator: Fred Zinnemann
note: 即将卸任的警长独自等待四名枪手，钟声倒计时把悬念压进每一分钟。
noteEn: A retiring marshal waits alone for four gunmen — a western ticking in real time.

title: 搜索者
creator: John Ford
note: 数年追凶穿越西部，约翰·韦恩的种族执念让英雄与怪物合二为一。
noteEn: Years of pursuit across the frontier — Wayne's bigotry blurs hero and monster.

title: 荒野大镖客
creator: Sergio Leone
note: 无名客挑动两大家族火并，翻拍黑泽明的同时让「通心粉西部片」横空出世。
noteEn: A stranger plays two clans against each other — the film that launched the spaghetti western.

title: 黄金三镖客
en: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
creator: Sergio Leone
note: 三个枪手寻宝的墓地决斗把对峙推向极致，莫里康内配乐与宽银幕的巅峰。
noteEn: Three gunmen hunt Confederate gold — a cemetery standoff and Morricone at his peak.

title: 西部往事
en: Once Upon a Time in the West
creator: Sergio Leone
note: 铁路时代的来临碾过旧西部，开场 20 分钟无对白的复仇戏却句句是戏。
noteEn: Railroads kill the old West — a wordless 20-minute opening that says everything.

title: 虎豹小霸王
en: Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid
creator: George Roy Hill
note: 两个被追杀的抢匪有说有笑地浪迹天涯，把西部片拍成最潇洒的双人喜剧。
noteEn: Two outlaws on the run, laughing all the way — the western as a buddy comedy.

title: 与狼共舞
creator: Kevin Costner
note: 一名军官投奔苏族印第安人，第一次真正站到原住民视角的西部史诗。
noteEn: A lieutenant goes native among the Sioux — the first great western from their side.

title: 不可饶恕
creator: Clint Eastwood
note: 退休枪手为赏金重出江湖，伊斯特伍德为整个西部神话亲手写下的挽歌。
noteEn: A retired gunman takes one last job — Eastwood's elegy for the western myth.

title: 豪勇七蛟龙
creator: John Sturges
note: 七名枪手保护墨西哥村庄，翻拍《七武士》的好莱坞西部群像经典。
noteEn: Seven gunmen defend a village — Hollywood's star-studded take on Seven Samurai.

title: 巴斯特·斯克鲁格斯的歌谣
creator: Joel & Ethan Coen
note: 六个风格迥异的西部短篇，科恩兄弟把死亡与荒诞嵌进明信片般的风景。
noteEn: Six very different tales of the frontier — the Coens frame death and absurdity beautifully.
